accepted_results: Every pentagon has at most two three-square edges in the stated quartic class.
For h=2 targets and Euler-genus-four ordinary hoppers, full-link components of the three-square subgraph have unique square decompositions.
Residual all-degree-two cycle components of length at least six are necessary; their total non-four-cycle length B is a positive multiple of four, B>=8, and |D2|>=2|F|+B.
No h=2 target or ordinary Euler-genus-four hopper has at most fifteen vertices.
